question: How many Olympic gold medals has the Indian men's hockey team won?
solution:
The correct answer is __**8**__.

**__Key Points__**

__

• The **Indian men's hockey team** holds the record for the most successful team in the history of the **Olympic Games**, having won a total of **8 gold medals**.

• India's dominance in world hockey began at the **1928 Amsterdam Olympics**, where they won their first gold medal without conceding a single goal throughout the tournament.

• The team achieved an extraordinary feat by winning **6 consecutive gold medals** between **1928 and 1956**. These victories occurred in **1928 (Amsterdam)**, **1932 (Los Angeles)**, **1936 (Berlin)**, **1948 (London)**, **1952 (Helsinki)**, and **1956 (Melbourne)**.

• Following the consecutive streak, India won two more gold medals at the **1964 Tokyo Olympics** and the **1980 Moscow Olympics**, bringing the total count to **8**.

• The **1980 Moscow** gold remains the last time the Indian men's hockey team stood at the top of the podium at the Olympics.

**Additional Information__**

__

• **Major Dhyan Chand**, often referred to as the **'Hockey Wizard'**, was the cornerstone of India's first three gold medal wins in **1928**, **1932**, and **1936**. His birthday, **August 29**, is celebrated as **National Sports Day** in India.

• The **1948 London Olympics** gold medal was a historic milestone as it was the first gold medal won by India as an **independent nation**, famously defeating **Great Britain** 4-0 in the final.

• In addition to the **8 gold medals**, India has won **1 silver medal** (1960) and **4 bronze medals** (1968, 1972, 2020, and 2024), making a total of **13 Olympic medals** in hockey.

• The **2020 Tokyo Olympics** saw India clinch a **bronze medal**, ending a **41-year-long** medal drought in the sport, followed by another **bronze** at the **2024 Paris Olympics**.

• The governing body for the sport in the country is **Hockey India**, which is affiliated with the **International Hockey Federation (FIH)**.

**Important Points__**

• **Balbir Singh Sr.** is another legendary figure who was part of three gold-winning teams (**1948, 1952, 1956**) and holds the record for the **most goals scored by an individual** in an Olympic men's hockey final (5 goals in 1952).

• India's **24-1** victory against the **USA** in the **1932 Los Angeles Olympics** remains one of the largest margins of victory in Olympic history.

• The **1975 Hockey World Cup** is the only time India has won the **World Cup** title, defeating **Pakistan** in the final held in **Kuala Lumpur**.
